split: User-level train/validation/test partition from taste.data.prepare. The scorer withholds 30% of each user's ratings (at least ten, at most 1,000).
method: Compare continued quiz with one optional, opportunity-triggered pair in the final decision window. Both arms use the same score-ordered slate of up to 15 held-out films, identical starting ratings and the same simulated time budget. Equal historical stars provide no preference.
interval: Paired mean difference plus or minus 1.96 times the standard error across held-out users with recommendations in both arms. Values are proportions, not percentages.
interpretation: Scores use historical ratings of films the user previously chose to watch. They do not measure elapsed interaction time, the probability of choosing a recommendation, or enjoyment after acting on it.
reproduce: python scripts/refinement_inputs.py --split test --users 5000 | node scripts/compare_picks.mjs --data site/data

validation400.metric: historical 4+ share of top three held-out films (paired ready users)

test5000.metric: historical 4+ share of top three held-out films (paired ready users)
